messages.subject: [R-SIG-RUGs] Website for RUG meeting materials (video, slides, R code)
messages.subject_clean: Website for RUG meeting materials (video, slides, R code)
messages.body_plain:
Please find here the link to the website aimed at collecting materials 
from local R user group meetings (and potentially other R related talks 
such as conferences, university lectures etc.) and making them 
accessible to the whole R community:
http://www.r-bloggers.com/RUG/

If you are RUG organizer, please consider video recording your talks and 
contribute them (see http://www.r-bloggers.com/RUG/?page_id=2 how). You 
are also welcome to contact me if you have any ideas, suggestions or 
comments.

Szilard
